searchText: R&D is ever expanding, beyond the base layer. This new channel is for everything about layer 2. Please keep it technical, do not shill products/chains here. So I'll just repeat my statement about necessity of having L2 standards. There are many L2 implementations and deployed systems but they generally can't talk to each other. I imagine solutions such as starkware are effectively standards. Are there more examples? Then we'll need adaptors for inter-standard interoperability. Adaptors exist such as connext. But the work of adaptors will get harder and harder absent standard L2 implementations. There should be standards for each type of L2 (e.g. stark, optimistic, etc), and then adaptors for each pairs of them. Vitalik had a proposal for cross L2 swaps.... But yeah not a standard yet. Erc20 took a bit before people had an idea of what was needed. This? https://ethresear.ch/t/cross-rollup-dex-with-smart-contracts-only-on-the-destination-side/8778 I think it just needs someone to implement it... (and yes I'm aware of the psychology research that shows that asking "someone" is the least effective possible way to get it actually done 🤣 ) actually I think I had read it. sign of old age. However, I didn't mean "exchange". just transferring tokens around. Ah sorry the word exchange was a misnomer This is more like a bridge oh ok then So is this method agnostic to what type of L2 we are working with? as long as they are rollups Part of the challenge is that L2s have to trust each other more since the originating erc20 token contracts don't control token ownership on L2... Yet. what if one is plasma, the other is rollup? or one is just state channel

excerpts.author: mohseng
excerpts.content:
So I'll just repeat my statement about necessity of having L2 standards.  There are many L2 implementations and deployed systems but they generally can't talk to each other.
I imagine solutions such as starkware are effectively standards.  Are there more examples?
Then we'll need adaptors for inter-standard interoperability.  Adaptors exist such as connext.  But the work of adaptors will get harder and harder absent standard L2 implementations.  There should be standards for each type of L2 (e.g. stark, optimistic, etc), and then adaptors for each pairs of them.
